implementation: C++17 CPU allocator and volatile byte loads; C#/.NET input, direct-DP planner, bitmap checker, C-ABI driver

synthetic_panel_rules.wide_rotate: 32 permanent pages; one required page t mod 32 each step
synthetic_panel_rules.wide_recycle: 8 slots, four successive generation cohorts of 16 steps; two required pages per step

baseline: fresh canonical R_t descriptor list at every query; same native buffer allocator, mask and load loop
certified: minimum publication plan from native-harness direct DP; checked with independent bitmap intervals and potentials; frozen costs matched to all 200 existing certificates
outputs: exact raw bit values for the union of mandatory atom lanes, canonical (page,lane) order per query; extra prefix loads are separately retained and consumed in sink
warmup: exactly two untimed complete baseline/certified setup-check-execution pairs per case
order: baseline then certified for even pair index; certified then baseline for odd index
execution: one pinned logical CPU; native steady-clock nanoseconds around eight full sequential trace replays; separate managed host envelope
separate_phases: separately measured complete plan/check/allocate/adapter/execute/free path from decoded input
summary: per-case median paired certified/baseline ratios for each phase and actual complete-from-decoded-trace run; full 11 raw pairs retained; min/max paired ratios and counts of slower certified pairs; no pooled speedup, invented sum-as-runtime, or discarded negative gains
timer_resolution: zero baseline phase ticks yield null ratios with an explicit below-resolution pair count; raw pairs and absolute times are retained
correctness: 207 native positive cases (200 frozen, three wide panel cases, four max-integer/address/empty/capzero controls); all 200 frozen costs and 400 checker mutants; complete audited loads for 14-case panel plus four edge controls; original source-separated Python checker validates all new plans; independent observer reconstructs every expected load and slot transition; four rejected runtime metadata controls never issue invalid loads
limits: not a GPU, service, production KV cache, neural attention or online implementation
publication weights are unchanged abstract weights, not fitted nanoseconds
native direct-DP overhead is not a timing of the original Python range-tree producer
sequential allocator snapshot controlled by this adapter; concurrent allocation and external trace authentication excluded
single-host blocked paired study; no confidence claim about serving populations
